name: Embalming Ichor
summary: In northern Tirisfal, Rot Hide gnolls carry a fluid that preserves their decaying bodies. The Forsaken Apothecaries seek to study it against the Scourge.

sections.title: Unnatural Preservation
sections.body: Rot Hide gnolls at Garren's Haunt and the nearby mass graves are rotting thralls sent by the Scourge to dig up plague victims. Embalming Ichor flows through their decayed veins, preserving their flesh and sustaining their unlife. Magistrate Sevren in Brill wants vials recovered from these grave robbers. The Royal Apothecary Society will use fresh specimens to study the fluid and seek ways to turn it against the Lich King's minions.

faq.answer: Embalming Ichor is a preserving fluid found in the animated bodies of Rot Hide gnolls in Tirisfal Glades. It sustains their rotting flesh and keeps them moving for the Scourge.
Magistrate Sevren in Brill orders Forsaken champions to collect ichor from slain Rot Hides for the Royal Apothecary Society to study.

faq.q: Why are the Rot Hide gnolls digging up graves?
faq.answer: The Scourge sends Rot Hide gnolls to dig up plague victims buried in the northern mass graves near Garren's Haunt, seeking bodies to bolster its ranks.

faq.q: What do the Forsaken plan to do with the fluid?
aliases: what does sevren do with ichor
faq.answer: The Apothecaries in the Undercity study the ichor for ways to counter the Scourge and for new alchemical formulas.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you deny the Scourge fresh cadavers from the mass graves, helping protect Tirisfal and securing raw materials for your own survival.
As a herbalist, you may find the preservation fluid inside Rot Hides intriguing as you study dark alchemical methods and the plague's reagents.
